# jwks — JSON Web Key Sets

[All groups](README.md)

## jwks fetch

Fetch a JWKS (directly or via an issuer's discovery document) and describe every key: kid, type, size, RFC 7638 thumbprint and any embedded certificate.

MCP tool: `jwks_fetch`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--issuer` | string | Issuer URL; its jwks_uri is discovered. |
| `--jwks-uri` | string | JWKS URL. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
